policy.description: Keep the OrcaTeal coding server pinned to upstream v1.4.176 and selectively cherry-pick only verified coding-server or mobile fixes.
policy.requiredTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> fleet SSH hosts
policy.forbiddenTopology: Air Raid UI -> Ultra Magnus runtime -> Air Raid SSH
policy.upstreamReviewRule: Never rebase or merge upstream wholesale. Every selective cherry-pick must run verify:teal-patch-stack against v1.4.176; exact upstream equivalents require an explicit keep/drop decision before release.
